text:
Alice F: Heads-up — I found two weird line items on invoice INV-2026-0312 (account: rw-infer-prod). One is a 'SpotInstance Repricing Adjustment' (-$7,432.12) which I expected, but there are two identical 'State Tax Surcharge' lines: $1,123.45 and another $1,123.45. Looks like the tax was charged twice. PDF attached in the thread.

invoicemon-bot: Parsed invoice INV-2026-0312 (extracted lines):
```
Line 102: SpotInstance Repricing Adjustment   -7432.12
Line 103: State Tax Surcharge                 1123.45
Line 104: State Tax Surcharge                 1123.45
Line 150: Commitment credit applied           -5000.00
```

Ben O: Which regions are affected? us-west2 or everywhere?

Alice F: Raw invoice shows region tags us-west2 and europe-west3 on different sections. The duplicated tax lines are in the top-level summary (no region), which is odd.

Carla M: Spot repricing makes sense when instances preempt and the provider issues an adjustment. Duplicate tax is suspicious though — could be tax applied to both original charge and the adjustment separately. The provider changed tax calc last quarter; remember the March change note.

Dan P: Do we have commitment/reserved capacity credits that should net before tax? If credits weren't netted correctly they might cause tax to be recomputed twice. I can pull the commitment ledger.

Evelyn G: Please run the billing export query — I want the raw BigQuery rows for invoice INV-2026-0312. SQL we normally use: 
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, line_item_id, description, amount, tax_amount, region
FROM `billing.raw_invoice_lines`
WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-2026-0312'
ORDER BY line_item_id
```

Ben O: Run it now, uploading results to the shared sheet. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/FAKE-BILLING-EXPORT (internal only). I see the two tax lines in the raw export too — same line_item_id? no, different ids.

Frank R: We also had a spot eviction spike in us-west2 on 2026-03-11 03:00 UTC where many workloads moved to on-demand. That would trigger repricing adjustments. But double tax shouldn't happen.

Carla M: Hypothesis: provider applied tax on original charge, then applied tax on the negative adjustment but failed to net the tax credit, thus leaving both tax charges on the invoice. We'll need provider confirmation.

invoicemon-bot: Flagging anomaly: duplicate tax lines detected (rule: duplicate_description_and_amount). Created internal incident INC-2026-214.

Alice F: Opening support case with provider — can someone cc the account rep? Also we need the journal entry impact for month-end if this doesn't get auto-corrected.

cloud-rep: Thanks for the report, we've located the invoice and are investigating. Preliminary: a recent billing pipeline change split tax calculation into two passes for repriced adjustments; a bug may have left both taxes on the final PDF while internal accounting netted them. We'll confirm asap. Case: PROVIDER-987321.

Dan P: Good. If provider nets on their side but the PDF shows duplicates, we still need corrected invoice for our auditors. Please request corrected invoice and xml/csv breakdown.

Evelyn G: While provider investigates, finance please prepare a temporary reversal JE for the duplicate $1,123.45 in our books so month close isn't blocked. Tag: accounting-temp-adjustment.

Ben O: For tracking: I exported the raw BQ rows and attached a csv to the case. Also added the cluster eviction logs to show correlation (pods rescheduled at 03:02 UTC).

Carla M: Next steps: (1) Provider to confirm whether tax was double-applied on PDF and whether backend accounting netted it; (2) Provider to issue corrected invoice if needed; (3) Finance to prepare temporary reversal JE if corrected invoice won't arrive before close; (4) Eng infra to add a note to the postmortem for the us-west2 eviction/billing correlation.

Alice F: Thanks. I'll follow up in 24 hours and escalate if we don't have a provider update. @cloud-rep please keep us posted. :thumbsup:

cloud-rep: Will update within 24 hours, assigned to billing-engine team.

Frank R: Also, can infra add a dashboard alert to correlate spot eviction events with repricing adjustments so we can pro-actively expect invoices like this?

Carla M: Yep, opening a small ticket to add a metric pair: spot_evictions vs repricing_adjustment_count.

Alice F: Closing note: booked potential $1,123.45 exposure until provider confirms.

Ben O: Confirmed — raw export has duplicate tax rows and different line_item_ids. Saved as sheet revision 5.

last message: cloud-rep: PROVIDER-987321 update queued, ETA 18-24h.
